en: A black‑and‑white multi‑view postcard with six photographs of landmarks and streets from the city of Pécs. The top left shows a large Romanesque‑style cathedral with four towers and a statue in front (Pécs Cathedral). Other views show civic buildings, a domed former mosque on a central square, a grand railway‑station‑like building, a clock‑tower on a street with a tram, and a square with a central statue and surrounding historic houses. The front caption, in Hungarian, reads "Üdvözlet Pécsről!" (Greetings from Pécs). The reverse side has handwritten Hungarian text, a Hungarian postage stamp labeled "Magyar Posta 40 f", and printed credits for the publisher in Budapest along with the words "Pécsi részletek."
